title: IVG Smart Max Tropical Fruits Prefilled Vape Pod + Refill
description: Tropical Fruits blends a vibrant mix of exotic fruit notes into a full-flavoured vape. Expect ripe, juicy highlights from fruits like Mango, Pineapple, and Passionfruit, layered together for a bright, sweet profile that stays fresh throughout. Each pack includes a 2ml pod prefilled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, plus a 10ml refill reservoir that feeds the pod automatically when connected. This system can support up to 10,000 puffs depending on your usage, with no need to refill or change coils. Fitted with mesh coil technology for consistent MTL vapour, this pod is designed for exclusive use with the IVG Smart Max Prefilled Pod Vape Kit. How to Set Up: Remove the red stoppers from the 2ml pod. Twist and remove the red safety cap from the 10ml refill reservoir. Insert the pod into the refill and press firmly until they click together. Insert the connected pod and refill into the Smart Max device.
